owner: Office of the Chief Risk & Compliance Officer

controls.name: Budget Variance Threshold Control
controls.description: Actual spend must not exceed budgeted spend by more than max_budget_variance_pct (10.0%) without an approved variance waiver.
controls.remediation: Obtain CFO variance waiver and execute cloud/vendor cost optimization plan.

controls.name: High-Value Expenditure & Wire Dual Approval
controls.description: Every vendor contract, amendment, or treasury disbursement >= $50,000 USD must have at least 2 distinct approvers including at least one Finance leadership role (CFO, VP_FINANCE, or CONTROLLER).
controls.remediation: Halt disbursement or amendment execution until a second distinct Finance approver signs off.

controls.name: Third-Party Vendor SOC2 Type II & DPA Verification
controls.description: Active vendors above $25,000 USD or handling CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED_FINANCIAL data must hold a non-expired SOC2 Type II report and signed DPA as of report_date.
controls.remediation: Suspend sensitive data or payment-rail integration and require current SOC2 Type II attestation and DPA.

controls.name: Treasury & Disbursement Segregation of Duties (SoD)
controls.description: No single employee may both initiate/prepare and approve or release the same treasury wire or high-value disbursement.
controls.remediation: Revoke conflicting RBAC permissions immediately, disable emergency self-override, and perform forensic review.

controls.name: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition & Period-Close Evidence
controls.description: Recognized revenue contracts must pass ASC 606 five-step verification and period-close bank reconciliations must be complete with zero items aged > 30 days.
controls.remediation: Complete ASC 606 technical accounting sign-off and clear aged suspense/reconciliation items prior to period close.
